pack.name: Surrealist Nature
pack.description: High-fashion models in extreme, minimalist landscapes with out-of-place architectural props. This pack embodies the Jacquemus-inspired surrealist aesthetic—dreamlike, high-contrast, and permanently iconic.

templates.title: Surreal - Desert Pink
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo. A stylish Black model in a flowing silk dress sitting on an oversized hot-pink velvet sofa in the middle of a vast, white salt flat desert. Blue sky, minimalist composition, surrealist Jacquemus aesthetic. 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Surreal - Poppy Mirror
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo. A handsome Black man in a tailored lime-green suit standing in a field of bright red poppies, holding a large, ornate silver mirror that reflects a different landscape. Surrealist nature vibe. 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Surreal - Ocean Giant Books
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo. A Black woman in an architectural white gown posing on a rocky ocean cliff next to a stack of giant, oversized books. Mist and dramatic lighting, ethereal surrealism. 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Surreal - Forest Bubble
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo. Close-up of a luxury leather handbag resting on a giant, floating transparent bubble in a serene forest setting. Soft dappled sunlight, magical realism aesthetic. 4:5 aspect ratio.
